title: Quickfire ops diary — PM daily (PRD edits, launch prep)
content:
Quickfire ops diary — short, messy capture for today

2026-03-09, morning sprint (9:15–11:30) — coffee on desk, triage mode
- Standup notes: canary window 10:00–12:00 PT. Ops ready, SRE wants 30m extra before traffic shift.
- Immediate todo: finalize PRD wording for routing fallback (small paragraph) and push to confluence.

PRD edits (micro-changes to push) — these are literal lines to paste into page:
1) Under "Fallback policy": "If primary model fails inference or latency > 2s for >5% of requests in rolling 1m window, route to same-arch quantized variant with cached-prefix enabled. Flag for telemetry: routing.fallback.reason / routing.fallback.variant."
2) Clarify "Canary success": "Canary considered successful when P95 latency <= 250ms and error-rate <= 0.5% over 15m window; otherwise auto-rollback triggers and notifications to #release-alerts."
3) Add step: "Post-rollout integrity checks: sample 50 requests against golden prompts set, run automated diff to ensure generation quality within acceptable divergence threshold (config in Optimize)."

Notes to self (format: quick prompts)
- Email to legal: cc compliance on routing opt-in for enterprise customers (short ask: confirm GDPR note).
- Slack: @Sana ask for a quick runbook stub for private deploys (we need to attach to PRD).
- Confirm Dedicated SKU numbering with finance before pricing doc finalization.

Stakeholder follow-ups (quick list)
- Eng: Liam — confirm kernel fallback path exists in runtime (asked in ENG-4821). Need reply by EOD to keep canary.
- SRE: Maya — request 30m extra in canary window and temporary elevated logging for routing.*
- Growth: Priya — update on docs for clients that rely on model pinning (note: add example curl + config).

Launch-day checklist (lean, for my pocket)
- [ ] Pre-canary smoke (infra): health checks green, autoscaler warmed
- [ ] Telemetry hooks present (latency, errors, token count, fallback events)
- [ ] Canary traffic plan uploaded (split config + timeframe)
- [ ] Alerting thresholds set & paging policy verified
- [ ] Rollback playbook linked in #release-alerts (1-liner steps)
- [ ] Customer comms draft ready (only if we flip to GA)
- [ ] Final PRD link + runbook attached to release ticket ENG-4821

Quick risk notes (short)
- Risk: cache inconsistency when toggling prefix-cache on quantized variant -> might change outputs for long-context prompts. Mitigation: run golden-sample diff, keep cold-start logs for 30m.
- Risk: quietly higher tail latency for very long sequences on smaller quantized model -> set hard token cap for canary.

Pieces to capture in tickets (add as comments to ENG-4821)
- Need explicit metric: routing.fallback.count and routing.fallback.latency (per-minute).
- Add integration test: direct compare of top-3 tokens for 20 golden prompts across variants.

Today timeline (personal)
- 08:45 prep, quick scan confluence + jira
- 09:15 standup + triage
- 10:00 sync with SRE (confirm canary window)
- 11:00 edit PRD + paste fallback wording
- 12:00 lunch (30m)
- 13:00 follow-ups (legal + growth)
- 14:00 final review before canary
- 15:30 support channel watch during initial traffic ramp

Draft text for Slack announcement (copy-paste friendly)
"Starting canary for Real-time routing v2 at 10:00 PT in staging -> dedicated pool. Canary criteria: P95 <= 250ms, error <= 0.5% over 15m. Auto-roll back if thresholds breach. Ops/SRE on-call during window; PM will monitor #release-alerts. Link to docs: <confluence link>"

Unresolved questions (stare at these)
- Do we want a soft-fail for enterprise with pinning enabled, or always enforce fallback? (ask legal + product)
- Should telemetry include input-hash to detect deterministic degrads on quantized models? Privacy implications — loop in privacy.

Misc scratch (brain dump)
- Idea: one-click debug mode for CS: attach sample request + automatic replay to sandbox variant (low-effort). Worth prototyping? Put as backlog item.
- PRD micro-note: include example YAML of routing rule (very small snippet).

End-of-day capture (to transfer to more formal doc)
- Move PRD edits into confluence page (small section with version history).
- Create follow-up tickets for test harness + metrics.
- Write short post-mortem template for rollout (if triggered).

Short signature: Aisha — pm; keep this messy until I close the loop.
